To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the impact of residual risk on performance is dependent on the type of performance being evaluated; and that (2) in Korea, the residual performance risk is a significant predictor of cost and schedule overrun, but not of subjective performance.

(1) objective measures of project performance are positively related to residual performance risk, and that (2) the relationship between objective measures of performance and residual risk is moderated by risk management strategies.

(1) the objective performance measures of cost overrun and schedule overrun are positively associated with software development performance risk in the Korean context; (2) the objective performance measure of schedule overrun is positively associated with software risk mitigation strategies; and (3) the objective performance of cost overrun and subjective performance of quality are negatively associated with software risk transfer strategies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the measurement of risk and performance in software development projects and how these measures relate to each other.
software project management and performance measurement, and it is motivated by a need to understand software development risk and project management in countries with dissimiliar IT capabilities.
how to manage software development risk, especially in countries with dissimilarity in IT capabilities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results from this study are consistent with the findings of the earlier studies that have been done on this subject.
software development risk management strategies and performance risk have a positive impact on objective performance in Korea.
, in the case of software outsourcing to countries with different IT capabilities, residual performance risk is a key determinant of project performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
software development risk is an important factor in determining project performance in Korea.
the risk management strategies and the residual performance risk have a positive effect on the objective performance of the software development in Korea.
the risk management strategies are not as effective in reducing residual risk as they are in reducing subjective performance risk.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the impact of software development risk is different for objective performance measures than it is for subjective performance measures.
software development risk management is a complex process and requires a more comprehensive approach than simply using the residual performance risk as a proxy for risk.
, while the impact of risk on performance is not a new concept, it is not well understood in software development.
